messages:
Maya (Product): Thanks for the all-hands — quick follow-ups on pipeline, GTM focus, and partnerships. TL;DR: need clarity on partner-led vs direct mixes, revenue crediting rules, and a partner-influenced pipeline view.

Ravi (Sales): Short answers: 1) Targeting ~60/40 partner-led to direct for enterprise ramp next quarter. 2) Revenue crediting: default referral = 30% Y1 unless co-sell. Legal/RevOps final sign-off pending. 3) Partner-opps view: Ben will share dashboard link.

Ben (GTM): Dashboard (internal): https://redwood.app/dashboards/partner-pipeline — Beta. Use filters: partner_tag, origin, mrr. I'll create a saved leadership view and share.

Elena (Partnerships): On enablement — partner onboarding kit goes live next week: playbook, pricing FAQ, joint demo checklist. We want 2 pilot partners for validation.

Priya (Rev Ops): Note on crediting: need legal-approved referral addendum. I'll draft a template by Wednesday. Example clause in draft: `Partner referral fee = 30% of first-year invoiced revenue, payable after invoice collection, subject to cancellation terms.`

Allison (CEO): High-level guidance — prioritize partners who help us penetrate regulated sectors (healthcare, finance). We'll allocate AM headcount to top 5 partners. Question: can onboarding compress from ~8w to ~4w? Elena, thoughts?

Elena (Partnerships): We can compress if Sales + Product commit to a predefined POA. Proposed: 3 weeks enablement (playbook + demo training) + 1 week tech onboarding for MVP integrations.

Maya (Product): Roadmap Q: will we add partner-specific routing/policy metadata (eg route-by-partner-SLA)? This was mentioned in the all-hands but need scope.

Ravi (Sales): Product priority looks high to us — helps sales motions for partners. Ben — can you confirm MVP scope/ETA?

Ben (GTM): MVP scope: partner tags, routing config, partner SLA metadata + saved pipeline view. ETA: internal beta by end of Q3. Canary with Partner X.

Maya (Product): Who owns rollout comms and sales playbook updates?

Priya (Rev Ops): I'll own comms and the playbook updates. Need final copy from Partnerships (Elena) and any technical notes from Product.

Elena (Partnerships): I'll post slides + onboarding checklist in #partners in ~30m. @Priya you can assign follow-ups there.

deploy-bot: Slide deck uploaded: https://redwood.app/files/allhands-q3-partners.pdf

Ravi (Sales): One open nuance — how do we credit a partner that influenced the deal (introduced upstream) but isn't on the final contract? Current rule is fuzzy.

Allison (CEO): Decision: adopt an "influence" credit for introductions. If partner led the first qualified touch, assign 20% influence credit unless sales documents show direct co-sell. We'll formalize in the partner policy doc.

Maya (Product): Thanks everyone. Action items: Ben to share saved dashboard view (done), Elena to post enablement assets (~30m), Priya to draft referral addendum by Wed, Allison to approve influence policy for inclusion in partner docs. Leaving this thread open for quick clarifications. :thumbsup:
